tasks.task: Plan a 30-day TikTok Shop launch

items.when: At the start of the job, to capture TikTok's current rules for the client's market on one dated sheet
When a client is opening a shop, or relaunching one that stalled
When you want a second week-by-week plan from the client's starting point to compare
When the shop has no clear voice, content pillars or story yet
When the brand has never posted and needs its first formats and routine
When the plan asks viewers to buy from day one and gives them nothing worth watching first
Before the 30 days are planned in detail, to compare two plans that split budget and effort differently

tasks.task: Pick hero products after fees and commission

items.when: When you need profit per order after platform fees, commission, shipping, returns and discount
When several products could lead and each needs a score and a verdict
When a hero product's price must be reset so it pays after every cost
When one product's sums are in doubt and you need true margin and break-even
Before the pick goes to the client, to test the method and the sums

tasks.task: Research trends and find products worth testing

items.when: When you have product sales graphs and need each scored as test or drop
When you want what is rising for a topic across TikTok and other platforms
When you need public videos, comments and numbers for a hashtag or rival account
When a trend looks tempting and you must judge if it is real and what stage it is at

tasks.task: Write TikTok Shop listings for a batch of products

items.when: When up to ten products need a title, selling points, description, sizes and image order
When you want a second title and description built for TikTok Shop search to compare
When a selling point is vague, to test it and get a true, picturable rewrite
Before a listing goes out, to catch unproven claims and false was-prices

tasks.task: Build a run sheet for a LIVE selling session

items.when: When one session needs a minute-by-minute plan with demos, offers, stock calls and a host checklist
When the seller is new to LIVE and wants another run order and host practice to compare
When the session could run as an auction or timed drops, with a profit sheet
When the host needs ready answers to the doubts viewers type in comments
When the offer uses limits or deadlines and each must be real and said plainly
Before going live, to check the script's claims, prices and disclosure lines
When the session talks about the product and should let viewers see it tried and working

tasks.task: Write shoppable video briefs tied to products

items.when: After hero products are picked, to plan ten videos with hook, proof shot and price moment
When you need a format for the product and who is on camera, with ten opening ideas
When a brief needs ten hooks checked for length and first shot
Before writing the briefs, to spread nine or more one-line video ideas across promises, proofs and formats
When hooks are drafted, to score each for the viewer and get rewrites
When a script is done, to check it still sells with the sound off
When the opening seconds do not pay off what the cover and first line promise

tasks.task: Script, film and edit a phone video

items.when: When a brief needs a 30-second phone script in five beats with a shot plan
When you want a second script from hook to call to action, with timed lines
When clips are shot and need a timed cut list, captions, a cover and export checks
When the seller edits on a phone and needs captions and resizing in one app
Before posting, to check what is said and shown against the product facts

tasks.task: Make a product video from photos when no one can film

items.when: Before making anything, to choose between generating, composing or editing real footage
When you have real product photos and an offer and need a 10 to 20 second video
When an idea needs a shot list with a prompt per shot and fixes for failed clips
When parts of the video are AI-made and may need a label under TikTok's rules

tasks.task: Set up creator affiliates, commission and samples

items.when: When you need the commission ceiling, sample rules and how requests are judged
When you want a second commission and sample setup from products and margins
When you must find creators, decide what to offer and track who replies
When you need a first list of creators in the niche with fit notes
When a creator asks for a flat fee and you must test it against their real views
When the shop wants a standing roster with a gifting funnel and a pay rule

tasks.task: Write a creator brief with disclosure rules

items.when: When the brief must state what to show, what not to claim and how to disclose
When you want a gifting plan, phone script and filming brief drafted from the org context
When the script is approved and the creator needs shoot order and file names
When the brief is drafted, to flag policy risks line by line with safer wording
Before the brief goes out, to check claims and that paid links are disclosed

tasks.task: Run the weekly shop review

items.when: Every week once the shop is live, with a monthly check of TikTok's rules
When you have seven days of exports and need what made money and three actions
When you need sales split by video, LIVE, creator and ad from the Seller Center numbers
When view counts are in and each video needs its weak point found: the hook or the hold
When you must decide which video formats earned another week

tasks.task: Turn one winning video into a repeatable format

items.when: When you need the posts that beat the account's normal reach and why they worked
When the winners should become a rubric that new hooks are graded against
When the winning format should be tried on other products as a batch of briefs
When the new versions are drafted, to score each hook before filming

tasks.task: Capture TikTok Shop's current rules for the market

items.when: At the start of each job and each month, so plans and margins use this month's rules
When existing listings and scripts should be re-read against the new sheet

tasks.task: Check claims, prices and disclosure before posting

items.when: Before a video, listing, LIVE script or creator brief goes out
When copy is long and each claim needs sorting as fine, needs proof or cut
When you have the client's evidence and must see which claims it supports
When a deadline or stock line fails the check and needs a real limit to replace it

tasks.task: Check fulfilment and returns before a launch or big LIVE

items.when: Before a launch, a sale or a big LIVE, or when late orders and returns rise
When a video may go viral and you need three demand cases with a response for each
Each morning after a spike, to find late and stuck orders before buyers write
When returns are rising and the seller needs refund timing and keep-it rules

tasks.task: Plan offers, bundles and flash deals that hold margin

items.when: When a sale needs a main offer and backups from stock and margin
When a hero product should sell in tiers or multi-buys with a clear default
When the planned discount must be tested against profit per order after fees and commission
Before the deal goes live, to find the deepest discount allowed and the wording to use

tasks.task: Plan and read TikTok Shop ads

items.when: When the shop has a budget and needs a plan for shopping ads, video ads and bids
When top products and a target cost per order are known and the campaign needs its settings
When organic or creator posts have results and you must pick which to boost
When test numbers are in and each ad needs a keep, fix or kill call
Before ad money is spent, to confirm the product is in stock at the stated price in the shop today

tasks.task: Plan the shop's weekly content calendar

items.when: When you know the products and need formats, hooks, hashtags and a calendar
When you want a second content plan with different formats and test ideas
Each week, to plan next week's posts from what worked last week
When the calendar should follow what made money, not what got views

tasks.task: Reply to comments, buyer messages and reviews

items.when: When comments pile up and the ones worth a reply need answers in the shop's voice
When you want what viewers ask and doubt, in their own words, for the next videos
When a buyer writes about an order or a delay and needs a clear reply
When replies promise dispatch or refund times that must match what the shop can do

tasks.task: Plan a TikTok Shop in another country

items.when: When the seller wants to know which markets to enter first, with shipping and rules
When the new market's fees and rules must be captured before any margin is quoted

always.when: Before anything a buyer will see goes out, to sort each claim as fine, needs proof or cut
Before any margin or results figure goes to the client, to test the sums

helpers.when: When paid TikTok campaigns need building, bidding and weekly changes
When the creator programme grows past a few creators and needs contracts and tracking
When raw clips need a proper edit, not a cut list for the seller
When the brand's wider social accounts must be planned alongside the shop
When dispatch, carriers or a fulfilment partner cannot meet the platform's times
When the shop's numbers must be read with the brand's own store and customer data

gaps: No library item holds TikTok Shop's fees, commission rules and dispatch times by market; only the kit's rules snapshot covers it
No library item reviews a finished LIVE session: sales per minute, which product order worked and where viewers left
No library item checks a finished shoppable video against the product facts and price before it is posted
No library item covers Seller Center shop health: violation points, warnings and appeals
No library item plans TikTok Shop's own promotion tools: flash deals, vouchers and free shipping offers
No library item sets rules for judging creator sample requests; only the kit skill covers it
No library item writes captions, hashtags and sound choices for shoppable videos as a set of options
No library item plans stock and dispatch for a sudden viral spike on one product
No English library item lays selling points on a main image, plans main image tests or localises listings for another country; those that exist are written in Chinese
